public_body: Fall River Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the minutes-response allegation because the Board was not shown to have received the October 13, 2024 request. It reminded the Board of minute-request and complaint-review procedures without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely respond within 10 days to an October 2024 emailed request for executive and open session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we are constrained to find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it did not respond to the request for minutes within 10 days of October 13, 2024.

allegations.summary: The letter notes the Board apparently did not review the complaint at a properly posted meeting and that counsel responded before any Board review.
allegations.key_passage: Proper procedure requires that a public body review a complaint before authorizing legal counsel to respond on its behalf.
